# Let's parse the note content to extract the songs with TODO
content = note['content']
lines = content.strip().split('\n')
todo_songs = []
for line in lines:
    if line.startswith('- '):
        line = line[2:]
        if ' RELEASED_AT TODO' in line:
            parts = line.split(' RELEASED_AT ')
            song_part = parts[0]
            # song_part is like "Silver Lining BY Ava Morgan"
            if ' BY ' in song_part:
                title, artists = song_part.split(' BY ', 1)
                todo_songs.append({'title': title, 'artists': artists})
print(todo_songs)
